knowledge_base: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 is the current recommendation; draft-07 is still common in tooling like ajv and jsonschema.
additionalProperties:false rejects unknown keys; pair it with patternProperties when extension keys are allowed.
Required is a sibling of properties, not a child — putting it inside properties is the most frequent author error.
$ref resolution can produce infinite loops if a schema references itself transitively; cap depth at 100.
Reporting all errors instead of bailing on first matches users' mental model of validation as a checklist.
Numeric type:integer rejects 1.0 in strict mode, but many validators accept it by default; document the choice.
Format keywords like 'email' and 'uri' are optional in 2020-12; validators should declare which formats they enforce.
Date-time format must follow RFC 3339; ISO 8601 weeks and ordinals are not allowed by the spec.
When a property's schema is boolean false, no value is valid for that property — including absence if required.
Error paths should use JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) so they round-trip into both editors and CI annotations.
